scope: Chrome viewport emulation of the real local App using controlled public test players; no room writes. Not physical iPad/Safari hardware.
checks: Ultimate folder and category tab retain amethyst facets, diagonal reflection and edge glints at zero energy; ordinary folders do not receive them.
Affordable enabled ultimate moves display transparent canvas flames; insufficient energy, disabled moves, locked cards and dead players suppress them; a free ultimate qualifies.

Canvas alpha contains visible pixels and frame hashes change during normal playback. Hidden and app/OS reduced-motion canvases remain unchanged; reduced-motion CSS reflections stop but static material remains.
Clicking neighboring folders and card details works through the transparent decorations. Actual horizontal skill tray scrolling and category tabs remain aligned without horizontal page overflow.
Energy toggles do not change board/table/hand geometry; aura anchor tracks folder/tab position, including toolbar height changes.
fixedDuringQA: Opening a category inserts a 33px toolbar without resizing the fixed hand or button; observation now includes hand child elements so the flame follows the tab.
shortLandscape: 844x390 permits vertical scrolling by design. Layout was compared in document coordinates and offscreen decorations stay hidden.

animation.method: Normal canvas/CSS rendering sampled approximately every 100ms; energy changes from 0 to 4 after 20 frames. No fake clocks.
